title: McKinsey.org Forward learning programme (Fall 2026)
overview: Free multi-week online programme teaching practical workplace skills: adaptability, communication, problem-solving, and digital and AI essentials. Applications are open until 5 October.
program_dates: Multi-week programme following the application window
deadline_text: Official FAQ, 2 November 2026: 'Applications are not open at the moment. However, you can still register your interest through this online form to stay informed ... when a new application cycle opens in your country.' The previous cycle closed on 2026-10-05 (earlier reading).
expected_next_cycle: Recurring programme; previous cycle closed on 2026-10-05.
funding_details: Official FAQ: 'No, Forward is free for eligible participants as part of McKinsey's social responsibility commitment. There are no fees to apply, register, or partake in any of the two levels, provided you are eligible.'
Participants use their own internet-connected device and internet access; ten weeks, about two hours a week for the Core Skills level
No stipend, travel or certificate fee is mentioned; this is a free online programme, not a funded mobility
participation_fee: None: 'There are no fees to apply, register, or partake'
eligibility: Live in a country where Forward is available; the FAQ's Africa list includes the Democratic Republic of the Congo
Working or with prior work experience (including internships or apprenticeships), or preparing to start work in the next 12 months
Less than 5 years of total work experience (exceptions stated for nonprofit, non-corporate or non-managerial roles)
At least a high school education or equivalent
Command of English, French, Brazilian Portuguese, Latin American Spanish or Arabic
experience_requirement: Reported: under 5 years of work experience; internships count
language_requirement: Primarily English; a secondary source says the digital content is also translated into French
application_process: Apply online from the Forward overview page before 5 October

sources.label: McKinsey.org Forward FAQ (deadline, eligibility, country list, no fees)

eligibility_reason: The official FAQ lists the DRC among Forward countries; internships count as prior work experience, total experience is under 5 years, and the course can be followed in English or French.
potential_issues: No application is open; the next cohort date is not announced
Missed applicants can only register interest; cohorts are delivered once a year and cannot be joined late
The programme is online and free: it brings no stipend and no travel
benefits: Skills that employers in the target roles ask for
relevance_reason: Free, short and aimed exactly at people starting their career. Problem-solving and digital skills are the gaps that business analyst and operations postings keep naming.
action: Applications are not open. Register your interest on the Forward page to be told when a new cycle opens in the DRC (the DRC is on the Africa list), and check the eligibility rules again then.
notes: Re-verified 5 October 2026: no extension and no spring 2027 cohort announced. Missed applicants 'can register their interest on the Forward website and will be contacted for the next cohort'.
